recipe: Pinned BiRefNet-matting: 1024 input only for mask inference, soft mask resized to unchanged original RGB dimensions. Opaque alpha>=.98 retains original RGB; soft edges unmix measured uniform plate. Alpha<8 removed; connected regions retained when containing alpha>=128. Fixed anatomical scale/anchor, no stabilization or interpolation.
edge_despill_recipe: After semantic alpha and measured plate unmix, reduce min(red,blue)-green only on soft nonzero alpha<250 edge pixels within two source pixels of the opaque boundary. Preserve legitimate green reed clothing/moss and all opaque RGB. Alpha, coordinates, anatomy, mallet, buckler and waist drum retained; no motion synthesis.
